TASK-2072 is up for review: PR #2831 https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2831, head 9ae7354b66041e1f52b17b750ea0693aacf66eb1.
No sketch was needed. Allow/deny outcomes are unchanged; only the refusal text changed, plus a shared helper.
- TASK-2055: NotDetected names the cause: no config, stopped at a temp root, config names a missing store (both paths named), or config has no store_path.
- TASK-2054/1666: a roster denial names an AIDA_STORE that resolves to a different usable store.
- TASK-1667: issuance and child delegation share roster_check, which resolves the store once.
- TASK-2071/1677: the TASK-1953 traces also name TASK-2054.
Gates: targeted tests 7/7, check-ci-fast OK, test-touched OK. seat_authority.rs is mandate-protected, so the operator merges. I have not shipped, merged or approved anything.
subject: TASK-2072 PR #2831 ready (head 9ae7354b66)
